sentences.en: And Headway's brief is to tackle big global challenges through the lens of progress.
sentences.zh: Headway 的宗旨是通过进步的视角来应对重大的全球挑战。

sentences.en: Homelessness is in a way just the visible tip of the iceberg of problems in the country.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，无家可归问题只是这个国家各种问题浮出水面的冰山一角。

sentences.en: The affordable housing crisis, poverty, racial inequities, substance and drug abuse and addictions, mental health.
sentences.zh: 可负担住房危机、贫困、种族不平等、物质和药物滥用及成瘾、心理健康。

sentences.en: All of them are sort of manifest by when you see people living in the streets.
sentences.zh: 当你看到人们露宿街头时，所有这些问题都会某种程度地显现出来。

sentences.en: Tackling homelessness is in fact a kind of triage.
sentences.zh: 解决无家可归问题实际上是一种分诊工作。

sentences.en: It's just dealing with a part of these larger probleMs. Among the things that I learned looking into
sentences.zh: 这只是在处理这些更大问题的一部分。在我研究无家可归问题及其历史的过程中，我学到的一点是，我们基本上为无家可归创造了所有的

sentences.en: homelessness and the history of homelessness is just how much we have basically created all the
sentences.zh: 条件，而就在几代人之前，我们所熟知的这种无家可归现象其实并不存在。

sentences.en: conditions for homelessness, which didn't really exist as we know it a couple of generations ago.
sentences.zh: 这是一个本身就很有趣的故事，但在我看来，这也意味着如果我们创造了无家可归，我们也能创造出解决它的办法。

sentences.en: And that's an interesting story in and of itself, but it also seems to me to imply that if we invented homelessness, we can also invent a solution to it.
sentences.zh: 围绕无家可归的许多讨论、你所阅读的许多内容，实际上都集中在你可能会称之为“贫困色情”的东西上，即我们所造成的苦难

sentences.en: So much of the conversation around homelessness, so many of the things you read, really focus on what you might call poverty porn, on the suffering and
sentences.zh: 和问题，而关于什么可能奏效的故事则相对少见。

sentences.en: the problems that we are creating, that it's rarer to read stories around what might work.
sentences.zh: 与关于人的故事相比，关于官僚机构和制度的故事可能更难引起共鸣。

sentences.en: And it can be harder to relate to stories about bureaucracy and systems than it is to stories about people.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，美国确实有一些城市正在取得进展。

sentences.en: It turns out that there are cities in America that actually are making progress.
sentences.zh: 但许多讨论不断把焦点拉回休斯顿。

sentences.en: But a lot of conversations kept returning to Houston.
sentences.zh: 它是全国第四大城市。

sentences.en: It is the fourth biggest city in the country.
sentences.zh: 它极其多元化。

sentences.en: It's extremely diverse.
sentences.zh: 它拥有许多我们与大城市无家可归问题相关联的挑战。

sentences.en: It has a lot of the challenges that we would associate with big city homelessness.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿真正专注于将人们直接从街头转移到公寓里。

sentences.en: Houston was really focused on moving people directly from the streets into apartments.
sentences.zh: 所以我想要去见见休斯顿的人们，看看他们在做什么，以及究竟是什么让他们似乎取得了成效。

sentences.en: So I wanted to meet the people in Houston and see what they were doing and what it is that seems to work.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是我的文章：

sentences.en: So here's my article,
sentences.zh: 休斯顿是如何将2.5万人从街头送入他们自己的家中的。

sentences.en: How Houston Moved 25,000 People from the Streets Into Homes of Their Own.
sentences.zh: 去年七月的一个闷热早晨，安娜·劳施占领了休斯顿西北部一个停车场阴凉的角落。

sentences.en: One steamy morning last July, Anna Rausch commandeered a shady corner of a parking lot on the northwest side of Houston.
sentences.zh: 她一口气喝完了一杯特大冰咖啡，向十多位手持 iPad 的外展工作者发出了干练的指令。

sentences.en: Downing a jumbo iced coffee, she issued brisk orders to a dozen outreach workers toting iPads.
sentences.zh: 她的注意力集中在附近的高速公路立交桥下，那里有几个人住在帐篷和纸板搭建的简易房里。

sentences.en: Her attention was fixed on a highway underpass nearby, where a handful of people were living in tents and cardboard lean-tos.
sentences.zh: 作为休斯顿无家可归者联盟的副总裁，

sentences.en: As the vice president of Houston's Coalition for the
sentences.zh: 劳施女士到那里是为了劝离他们。

sentences.en: Homeless, Ms. Rausch was there to move them out.
sentences.zh: 我来这里是为了观察这个过程，更广泛地了解休斯顿应对无家可归的方法，该方法赢得了许多赞誉。

sentences.en: I had come to watch the process and more broadly to see Houston's approach to homelessness, which has won a lot of praise.
sentences.zh: 起初，我无法理解为什么这个特定的立交桥下会被人占据。

sentences.en: At first, I couldn't figure out why this particular underpass had been colonized.
sentences.zh: 卡车轰鸣发动机的声音像步枪射击一样在混凝土墙壁上回荡，而且休斯顿绝大多数无家可归者服务机构都在数英里之外。

sentences.en: The sound of trucks revving their engines ricocheted against the concrete walls like rifle shots, and most of Houston's homeless services were miles away.
sentences.zh: 但随后，劳施女士的团队和几位营地居民指出了附近的快

sentences.en: But then Ms. Rausch's team and a few camp residents pointed out the nearby fast
sentences.zh: 餐店、带有便利店的壳牌加油站，以及 Planet Fitness 健身房——在那里，每月10美元的会员费意味着可以使用淋浴间和为手机充电的电源插座。

sentences.en: food outlets, the Shell station with a convenience store, and the Planet Fitness, where a $10 monthly membership meant access to showers and outlets for charging phones.
sentences.zh: 一开始也不明显，是什么将这次营地清理与洛杉矶和奥斯汀等城市的清理区分开来，

sentences.en: It also wasn't initially visible what distinguished this encampment clearance from the ones in cities like Los Angeles and Austin,
sentences.zh: 在那些地方，无家可归的人数一直在飙升，挫败感也随之增加。

sentences.en: where the number of homeless people has been skyrocketing, along with frustrations.
sentences.zh: 之所以看不出区别，是因为它已经发生了。

sentences.en: The difference couldn't be seen because it had already happened.
sentences.zh: 一个多月以来，劳施女士和她的同事们一直在与哈里斯县官员以及市长办公室和当地房东进行协调。

sentences.en: For more than a month, Ms. Rausch and her colleagues had been coordinating with Harris County officials, as well as with the mayor's office and local landlords.
sentences.zh: 他们曾造访营地并与住在那里的人交谈，因此现在，当帐篷被拆除时，居住者可以直接搬进一居室公寓，

sentences.en: They had visited the encampment and talked to people living there, so that now, as tents were being dismantled, the occupants could move directly into one-bedroom apartments,
sentences.zh: 一些人住一年，另一些人住更久。

sentences.en: some for a year, others for longer.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，住在营地里的人不会被发配到无家可归者收容所、因私闯民宅而被传讯或四处流落，而是被赋予了一个家。

sentences.en: In other words, the people living in the encampment would not be consigned to homeless shelters cited for trespassing or scattered to the winds, but rather given a home.
sentences.zh: 在过去的十年里，作为全美人口第四大城市，休斯顿已将超过2.5万名无家可归者直接安置到公寓和房屋中。

sentences.en: During the last decade, Houston, the nation's fourth most populous city, has moved more than 25,000 homeless people directly into apartments and houses.
sentences.zh: 其中绝大多数人在两年后依然拥有住所。

sentences.en: The overwhelming majority of them have remained housed after two years.
sentences.zh: 根据当地官员的最新数据，自2011年以来，休斯顿地区被认为无家可归的人数减少了63%。

sentences.en: The number of people deemed homeless in the Houston region has been cut by 63 percent since 2011, according to the latest numbers from local officials.
sentences.zh: 即使以2020年联邦报告中较为保守的指标来衡量，休斯顿在过去十年中减少无家可归者方面的成效也是全国其他地区的两倍

sentences.en: Even judging by the more modest metrics registered in a 2020 federal report, Houston did more than twice
sentences.zh: 多。

sentences.en: as well as the rest of the country at reducing homelessness over the previous decade.
sentences.zh: 十年前，无家可归的退伍军人（联邦政府追踪的类别之一）需要等待720天，

sentences.en: Ten years ago, homeless veterans, one of the categories that the federal government tracks, waited 720 days
sentences.zh: 必须经过76个官僚步骤，才能在社会服务顾问的支持下从街头进入永久住房。

sentences.en: and had to navigate 76 bureaucratic steps to get from the street into permanent housing with support from social service counselors.
sentences.zh: 如今，精简的流程意味着住房等待时间缩短为32天。

sentences.en: Today, a streamlined process means the wait for housing is 32 days.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿之所以能取得今天的成就，是因为它与县级机构合作，说服了大量的本地服务

sentences.en: Houston has gotten this far by teaming with county agencies and persuading scores of local service
sentences.zh: 提供商、企业和慈善非营利组织——这些经常争吵和竞争的组织——齐心协力。

sentences.en: providers, corporations, and charitable nonprofits, organizations that often bicker and compete with one another, to row in unison.
sentences.zh: 他们共同全力推行“住房优先”政策，这是一项得到数十年研究支持的做法，将最脆弱的人群直接从街头送入公寓，

sentences.en: Together, they've gone all in on housing first, a practice supported by decades of research that moves the most vulnerable people straight from the streets into apartments,
sentences.zh: 而不是送入收容所，并且不要求他们首先戒除毒瘾、完成12步戒瘾计划、找到信仰或工作。

sentences.en: not into shelters, and without first requiring them to wean themselves off drugs or complete a 12-step program or find God or a job.
sentences.zh: 确实有成瘾康复和宗教皈依项目成功让人们离开街头，但“住房优先”遵循的是不同的逻辑。

sentences.en: There are addiction recovery and religious conversion programs that succeed in getting people off the street, but housing first involves a different logic.
sentences.zh: 当你快要淹死时，如果救援人员坚持要求你先学会游泳再把你拉回岸上，那是毫无帮助的。

sentences.en: When you're drowning, it doesn't help if your rescuer insists you learn to swim before returning you to shore.
sentences.zh: 然而，一旦你上了岸，你就可以解决你的问题。

sentences.en: However, you can address your issues once you're on land.
sentences.zh: 或者不解决也行。

sentences.en: Or not.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，你都加入了关起门来与心魔搏斗的庞大群体之中。

sentences.en: Either way, you join the wider population of people battling demons behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 西尔维斯特·特纳告诉我：“在我离任之前，我希望休斯顿成为第一个消除长期无家可归现象的大城市。”

sentences.en: Before I leave office, I want Houston to be the first big city to end chronic homelessness, Sylvester Turner told me.
sentences.zh: 1月下旬，即将结束市长最后一个任期的特纳先生与哈里斯县领导人一同公布了一项1亿美元的计划，

sentences.en: In late January, Mr. Turner, who was serving his final term as mayor, joined Harris County leaders in unveiling a $100 million plan
sentences.zh: 该计划将利用联邦、州、县和市的资金组合，在2025年之前将当地无家可归人数再次减半。

sentences.en: that would use a mix of federal, state, county, and city funds to cut the local homeless count in half again by 2025.
sentences.zh: 特纳先生字斟句酌，剖析他的措辞很重要。

sentences.en: Mr. Turner chose his words with care, and it's important to parse his phrasing.
sentences.zh: 长期无家可归是一个专业术语。

sentences.en: Chronic homelessness is a term of art.
sentences.zh: 它指的是那些像休斯顿营地中的许多人一样，在街头生活了一年多，或者多次无家可归，

sentences.en: It refers to those people, like many in the Houston encampment, who have been living on the streets for more than a year, or who have been homeless repeatedly,
sentences.zh: 并且患有精神或身体残疾的人。

sentences.en: and who have a mental or physical disability.
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，大多数经历无家可归的人并不属于这个狭隘的类别。

sentences.en: Nationwide, most of those who experience homelessness do not fall into that narrow category.
sentences.zh: 他们无家可归的时间为六周或更短。

sentences.en: They're homeless for six weeks or fewer.
sentences.zh: 百分之四十的人有工作。

sentences.en: Forty percent have a job.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，无家可归是一种痛苦但暂时的状况，他们设法通过与亲戚或朋友挤在一起等方式来解决。

sentences.en: For them, homelessness is an agonizing but temporary condition that they manage to resolve, maybe by doubling up with relatives or friends.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，还有数以千计的母亲和儿童，以及居无定所的青少年和年轻人，他们居住条件糟糕且面临风险。

sentences.en: There are, at the same time, many thousands of mothers and children, as well as couch-surfing teenagers and young adults who are ill-housed and at risk.
sentences.zh: 这些人同样贫穷且绝望。

sentences.en: These people are also poor and desperate.
sentences.zh: 找到一个睡觉的地方对他们来说可能是每日的挣扎。

sentences.en: Finding a place to sleep may be a daily struggle for them.
sentences.zh: 他们可能离流落街头只差一次变速箱损坏或急诊室就诊。

sentences.en: They might be one broken transmission or emergency room visit away from the streets.
sentences.zh: 他们正处于通往无家可归的管道中，但按照官僚定义，他们并非无家可归。

sentences.en: They're in the pipeline to homelessness, but they are not homeless according to the bureaucratic definition.
sentences.zh: 他们没有睡在人行道上、汽车里或收容所里。

sentences.en: They are not sleeping on a sidewalk or in their cars or in shelters.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿可以向这些人伸出援手，但特纳先生并不承诺结束他们生活的不稳定性。

sentences.en: Houston can offer these people a hand, but Mr. Turner is not promising to end the precariousness of their lives.
sentences.zh: 劳施女士这样说道：“我们不是来解决贫困问题的。”

sentences.en: We are not here to solve poverty.
sentences.zh: 我们不是来解决可负担住房问题的，

sentences.en: We aren't here to fix the affordable housing problem, is how Ms. Rausch puts it, adding,
sentences.zh: 她补充道：“把美国的无家可归系统想象成针对贫困中被分诊的那一部分人的急诊室。”

sentences.en: think of the homeless system in America as an emergency room for a triaged slice of poverty.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿所取得的成就是，在应对这一挑战方面取得了足够大的进展，以至于我们有望开始考虑通往无家可归的管道问题。

sentences.en: What Houston has achieved is to get itself far enough along in addressing the challenge that we can hope to begin to think about the pipeline to homelessness.
sentences.zh: 像立交桥下那样的营地暴露出规划者、政治家以及健康和住房主管当局数十年来灾难性的决策。

sentences.en: Encampments like the one in the underpass lay bare decades of calamitous decisions by planners, politicians and health and housing authorities.
sentences.zh: 每14个美国人中就有一个人在某个时期经历过无家可归，这一群体中黑人比例过高。

sentences.en: One in every 14 Americans experiences homelessness at some point, a population that is disproportionately black.
sentences.zh: 根除无家可归将涉及解决系统性种族主义，重组国家的心理健康、

sentences.en: Eradicating homelessness would involve tackling systemic racism, reconstituting the nation's mental health,
sentences.zh: 家庭支持和药物滥用系统，提高工资，扩大联邦住房券计划，并建造数百万套更多的补贴住房。

sentences.en: family support and substance abuse systems, raising wages, expanding the federal housing voucher program, and building millions more subsidized homes.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿以及其他正在攻克这一问题的城市的目标则不同。

sentences.en: The goal in Houston, and among other cities attacking the problem, is different.
sentences.zh: 正如住房倡导者罗珊妮·哈格蒂所说，使无家可归变得“罕见且短暂”。

sentences.en: To make homelessness only, quote, rare and brief, to cite Roseanne Haggerty, the housing advocate.
sentences.zh: 五个州——加利福尼亚州、纽约州、佛罗里达州、

sentences.en: Five states, California, New York, Florida,
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州和德克萨斯州——目前占无家可归人口的57%。

sentences.en: Washington, and Texas, now account for 57 percent of the people experiencing homelessness.
sentences.zh: 并非巧合的是，在那些可负担住房短缺、

sentences.en: Not coincidentally, it is worse in those big cities where affordable housing is in short supply,
sentences.zh: 所谓的“邻避效应”强大、且中位收入与住房成本之间不断扩大的鸿沟日益拉大的大城市里，情况更糟。

sentences.en: the so-called NIMBYs are powerful, and the yawning gap between medium incomes and the cost of housing keeps growing.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿符合这一描述。

sentences.en: Houston fits that description.
sentences.zh: 其困境的规模不及旧金山、纽约或洛杉矶正在发生的事情，但它在安置人们方面取得的进展具有启发性和可复制性。

sentences.en: The scale of its woes does not approach what is happening in San Francisco, New York, or Los Angeles, but the progress it has made in housing people is instructive and replicable.
sentences.zh: 它构成了一种脆弱而引人注目的成功。

sentences.en: It constitutes a fragile, compelling success.
sentences.zh: 在那个七月下午的中午前后，劳施女士的团队已经将营地里的居民转移到了他们的新住所。

sentences.en: By mid-afternoon on that July day, Ms. Rausch's team had transferred those living in the encampment to their new residences.
sentences.zh: 被重新安置的人中有一位39岁害羞的女性，名叫特里·哈里斯。

sentences.en: Among the people relocated was a shy 39-year-old woman named Terry Harris.
sentences.zh: 当外展工作者在营地接近她时，哈里斯女士对拥有公寓的前景欣然接受。

sentences.en: Ms. Harris had leaped at the prospect of an apartment when outreach workers approached her in the camp.
sentences.zh: 她厌倦了过街头生活，但最重要的是，她极度渴望与她三岁的女儿布莱西团聚，她不得不把女儿留在她姐姐那里。

sentences.en: She was tired of living on the streets, but above all, she was desperate to reunite with her three-year-old daughter, Blessed, whom she had had to leave with her sister.
sentences.zh: 两名外展工作者将哈里斯女士塞进一辆白色的面包车，车上还有一个塞满日用品的大垃圾袋和一本圣经。

sentences.en: Two outreach workers packed Ms. Harris into a white van along with a hefty trash bag stuffed with household supplies and a Bible.
sentences.zh: 面包车开走时，哈里斯女士看起来有点紧张，但脸上带着微笑。

sentences.en: Ms. Harris looked nervous but smiled as the van drove off.
sentences.zh: 车程的终点是一间一居室公寓。

sentences.en: At the end of the ride was a one-bedroom apartment.
sentences.zh: 半个世纪前，美国发明了现代无家可归现象。

sentences.en: Half a century ago, America invented modern homelessness.
sentences.zh: 随着虐待丑闻爆发后精神病院的关闭以及新型精神药物的引入，这一局面的舞台就此搭好。

sentences.en: The stage was set with the shuttering of psychiatric hospitals in the wake of abuse scandals and the introduction of new psychotropic medications.
sentences.zh: 随后，城市开始向廉价旅馆或单间公寓（SRO）酒店的业主提供税收优惠，以将他们的房产改造成按市价出租的公寓、产权公寓和合作公寓。

sentences.en: Then cities started offering tax incentives to owners of flophouses or single-room occupancy hotels to convert their properties into market-rate rentals, condos, and co-ops.
sentences.zh: 仅在纽约市，就有超过10万套曾为吸毒者、老年

sentences.en: In New York City alone, more than 100,000 SRO units that had housed substance abusers, elderly
sentences.zh: 单身汉、前囚犯和精神病患者提供住所的 SRO 单位消失了。在20世纪80年代，接连的经济衰退，

sentences.en: singles, former inmates, and the mentally ill were loSt. During the 1980s, back-to-back recessions,
sentences.zh: 加上里根政府针对低收入住房

sentences.en: combined with the Reagan administration's severe federal cutbacks targeting low-income housing
sentences.zh: 和贫困援助计划的大幅联邦削减，迫使越来越多的美国人（包括大量家庭）陷入无家可归。

sentences.en: and poverty assistance programs, forced more and more Americans, including large numbers of families, into homelessness.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，薪酬优厚的制造业工作岗位流失到海外，钢铁工人不得不开始在麦当劳扫地。

sentences.en: At the same time, well-paid manufacturing jobs moved overseas and steelworkers had to start pushing brooms at McDonald's.
sentences.zh: 石油危机推高了燃料价格，进而推高了房租，新一代发现了历史街区建筑魅力的绅士化改造者也是如此。

sentences.en: An oil crisis drove up fuel prices, which bumped up rents, as did a new generation of gentrifiers discovering the architectural pleasures of historic neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，里根时代的税收改革鼓励建造高端单户住宅，而不是经济实惠的多户租赁住宅。

sentences.en: On top of all that, Reagan-era tax reforms encouraged the construction of high-end single-family homes, but not of affordable multi-family rentals.
sentences.zh: 1985年美国建造了51.5万套多户住宅，但1991年仅建造了14万套。

sentences.en: There were 515,000 multi-family homes built in America in 1985, but just 140,000 built in 1991.
sentences.zh: 随着人们开始争夺越来越少的公寓，可负担住房市场变成了一场由低收入美国人进行的抢椅子游戏。

sentences.en: As people began competing for fewer and fewer apartments, the affordable housing market turned into a game of musical chairs played by low-income Americans.
sentences.zh: 总有人会失去住所。十年前，休斯顿的人均无家可归人数曾居全国前列。

sentences.en: Someone always loSt. A decade ago, Houston had one of the highest per capita homeless counts in the country.
sentences.zh: 其无家可归者应对系统处于崩溃状态。

sentences.en: Its homeless response system was in shambles.
sentences.zh: 该市因逮捕醉酒的休斯顿无家可归者而挥霍了数百万公共资金和警察的时间。

sentences.en: The city was squandering millions of public dollars and police officers' time by jailing homeless Houstonians for intoxication.
sentences.zh: 由于没有其他途径，生活在街头、桥下和河口旁的居民不得不使用救护车来获得基本的医疗护理。

sentences.en: Residents living on the streets, under bridges, and along the bayous were using ambulances to get basic medical care because they had no other way to do so.
sentences.zh: 而且，与其他城市一样，数十个公共和私营的当地援助组织各自为政，争夺联邦资金，重复提供服务，

sentences.en: And, as in other cities, dozens of local aid organizations, public and private, were operating in silos, competing for federal funds, duplicating services,
sentences.zh: 不分享信息或目标，安置的人少之又少。

sentences.en: not sharing information or goals, housing precious few people.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡·普莱海姆是休斯顿无家可归者联盟负责战略规划的副总裁，也是劳施女士的同事之一，

sentences.en: Jessica Preheim, the vice president for strategic planning at Houston's Coalition for the Homeless and one of Ms. Rausch's colleagues,
sentences.zh: 她记得每隔五六年，休斯顿住房管理局就会为任何希望进入联邦住房券等待名单的人宣布一次抽签。

sentences.en: remembers that every five or six years, the Houston Housing Authority would announce a lottery for anyone hoping to get on the waiting list for federal housing vouchers.
sentences.zh: 正如普莱海姆女士所回忆的那样，如果你想参加抽签，你需要先听到公告，然后在抽签结束前的几天内提交书面

sentences.en: As Ms. Preheim recalls, if you wanted to enter the lottery, you needed first to hear the announcement, then submit an
sentences.zh: 申请。

sentences.en: application in writing within a few days before the lottery closed.
sentences.zh: 如果奇迹发生，你的名字被抽中，你将通过平信收到通知，这当然需要一个街道地址。

sentences.en: If, by some miracle, your name were drawn, you would receive notification by snail mail, which of course required a street address.
sentences.zh: 这是一个注定无法妥善安置无家可归者的方案。

sentences.en: It was a recipe for not housing homeless people.
sentences.zh: 陶·科斯塔斯在休斯顿经营一家名为 Search 的无家可归者服务机构，她说当时她的组织和城里的许多机构一样，试图包办一切，

sentences.en: Tao Costas, who runs a homeless service provider in Houston called Search, said that back then her organization, like many in the city, was trying to do everything,
sentences.zh: 外展、个案管理、儿童服务、就业培训、向房东支付租金以安置客户。

sentences.en: outreach, case management, child services, employment training, paying rent to landlords to house clients.
sentences.zh: 科斯塔斯女士记得，Search 当时背负了一百万美元的债务，而最需要帮助的人却没有得到帮助。

sentences.en: Search was one million dollars in the hole, Ms. Costas remembers, and the people who most needed help weren't getting it.
sentences.zh: 开始带来改变的是2009年《HEARTH法案》的通过，该法案

sentences.en: What started to bring about change was the passage in 2009 of the HEARTH Act, which
sentences.zh: 规定，为了获得联邦资金，城市必须采取“住房优先”政策，并且

sentences.en: stipulated that in order to receive federal dollars, cities had to adopt a housing-first policy and,
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，无家可归者组织必须在单一牵头机构的护理连续体下共同合作，协调其计划并共享数据。

sentences.en: crucially, that homeless organizations had to work together in continuums of care under a single lead agency, coordinating their programs and sharing data.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府自1994年以来一直建议建立这些护理连续体，但直到《HEARTH法案》出台，资金才与具体的效能指标挂钩。

sentences.en: The federal government had recommended these continuums of care since 1994, but not until the HEARTH Act was funding tied to specific metrics of effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 随着新规定于2012年生效，奥巴马政府的

sentences.en: With the new regulations set to take effect in 2012, the Obama administration's
sentences.zh: 住房和城市发展部向10个无家可归问题尤为严重的城市提供了资金和专业知识。

sentences.en: Department of Housing and Urban Development offered money and expertise to 10 cities where homelessness was a particular problem.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿就是其中之一。

sentences.en: Houston was among them.
sentences.zh: 安妮斯·帕克当时是休斯顿市长。

sentences.en: Anise Parker was Houston's mayor at the time.
sentences.zh: 我今年早些时候去拜访了她。

sentences.en: I went to see her earlier this year.
sentences.zh: 她和妻子凯西·哈伯德住在蒙特罗斯街区一条美丽的绿树成荫的街道上一栋建于1904年的三层山形墙房屋里。

sentences.en: She lives with her wife, Kathy Hubbard, in a three-story gabled house built in 1904 on a pretty tree-lined street in the Montrose neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 帕克女士的门厅里挂着她和哈伯德女士从寄养家庭中收养的三个女儿的带框照片，

sentences.en: Hanging in Ms. Parker's foyer are framed photographs of the three daughters she and Ms. Hubbard adopted
sentences.zh: 以及一个十几岁男孩的照片，他现在是一名40岁左右的成年人，曾是从祖父母身边

sentences.en: out of foster care, as well as of a teenage boy, now a man in his mid-40s, a runaway from grandparents
sentences.zh: 出走的出走少年。

sentences.en: who tried to force the gay out of him, Ms. Parker says, who was living on the streets when they took him in.
sentences.zh: 帕克女士说，他们接纳了他，当时他在街头流浪，试图强行纠正他的同性恋倾向。

sentences.en: Ms. Parker is the opposite of a slick politician, blunt, wonky, unassuming.
sentences.zh: 帕克女士完全不是那种老于世故的政客，她直率、务实而谦逊。

sentences.en: A software analyst in the oil and gas industry for 20 years, she became city controller, managing Houston's money,
sentences.zh: 她在石油和天然气行业担任了20年软件分析师，后来成为休斯敦的市主计长，管理着休斯敦的财政，

sentences.en: before being elected America's first openly lesbian big city mayor in 2009.
sentences.zh: 并在2009年当选为美国首位公开同性恋身份的大城市市长。

sentences.en: She won with bipartisan support as a Democrat on a centrist platform of fiscal responsibility.
sentences.zh: 作为一名民主党人，她凭借以财政责任为核心的中间派纲领，赢得两党支持并当选。

sentences.en: Through our son, I had an up-close and personal look at what life was like for somebody on the streets who was treated as disposable, Ms. Parker told me.
sentences.zh: 帕克女士告诉我：“通过我们的儿子，我得以近距离地了解那些被视为无用之物、流落街头的人的生活是怎样的。”

sentences.en: Different organizations were all working in their own lanes, according to their own rules and procedures, doing what they wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 不同的组织过去都各自为战，按照自己的规则和程序行事，做着他们想做的事。

sentences.en: There might be 100 open shelter beds on a given night, designated for mothers with kids, but we didn't have mothers with kids who needed beds.
sentences.zh: 在某一个夜晚，可能有一百张专为带孩子的母亲预留的庇护所空床位，但我们却没有需要床位的带孩子的母亲。

sentences.en: The White House offered an expert on homeless aid, Mandy Chapman Semple, to help Ms. Parker herd the cats.
sentences.zh: 白宫派遣了一位流浪者救助专家曼迪·查普曼·森普尔，来协助帕克女士理顺这些乱局。

sentences.en: They invited dozens of the city's homeless service providers to a meeting.
sentences.zh: 他们邀请了该市数十家流浪者服务机构开会。

sentences.en: We started talking to each other, is how Ms. Preheim remembers that moment.
sentences.zh: 普赖姆女士回忆当时的情景时说，我们开始互相交流。

sentences.en: Sometimes it is as simple as that.
sentences.zh: 有时事情就是这么简单。

sentences.en: The continuum was given a name, The Way Home, and the nonprofit Coalition for the Homeless of Houston Harris County was appointed its lead agency.
sentences.zh: 这个服务联合体被命名为“归宿”，非营利机构休斯敦哈里斯县流浪者联盟被指定为其牵头机构。

sentences.en: Some food banks and religious and other service providers that made prayer or sobriety conditions
sentences.zh: 一些将祈祷或戒酒作为入住条件的食品银行、宗教及其他服务机构

sentences.en: for housing did not join, but more than 100 local and regional organizations eventually signed on.
sentences.zh: 没有加入，但最终有一百多家地方和区域组织签署了加入协议。

sentences.en: Houston started collecting real-time data, as opposed to relying solely on a once-a-year census.
sentences.zh: 休斯敦开始收集实时数据，而不是仅仅依赖一年一次的人口普查。

sentences.en: At first, the goal was to house 100 homeless veterans in 100 days, and after that was achieved,
sentences.zh: 起初，目标是在100天内为100名流浪退伍军人提供住房，而在达成这一目标后，

sentences.en: 300 more in another 100 days.
sentences.zh: 又在另外100天内为300人提供了住房。

sentences.en: Then we thought, if we can do that, we can do something really big,
sentences.zh: 帕克女士告诉我：

sentences.en: Ms. Parker told me.
sentences.zh: “然后我们想，如果我们能做到这一点，我们就能做一件真正大事。”

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用程式？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: It may seem surprising that of all cities, Houston, built on a go-it-alone oil business culture, decided to tackle homelessness by, in effect, collectivizing its homeless relief
sentences.zh: 在所有城市中，建立在单打独斗的石油商业文化基础上的休斯敦，却决定通过实际上将流浪者救助系统集体化的方式来解决流浪问题，

sentences.en: system.
sentences.zh: 这或许会令人感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Houston is a business-friendly city in a purple county in a red state, with more than its share of neighborhood housing covenants.
sentences.zh: 休斯敦是一个对商业友好的城市，位于一个摇摆郡和一个红州，这里有相当多的社区住房契约。

sentences.en: But Houstonians will tell anyone willing to listen that they are nothing if not pragmatic.
sentences.zh: 但任何愿意倾听的人都会听到休斯敦人说，他们最不缺的就是务实精神。

sentences.en: The Houston Housing Authority joined the continuum.
sentences.zh: 休斯敦住房管理局加入了这个服务联合体。

sentences.en: It agreed that 250 homeless clients a year could jump to the top of the waiting list for vouchers.
sentences.zh: 它同意每年让250名流浪者客户直接排到住房券等待名单的最前面。

sentences.en: Since that change, thousands have received vouchers and been housed.
sentences.zh: 自这一改变以来，数千人已经获得了住房券并住进了房屋。

sentences.en: Search also joined.
sentences.zh: Search组织也加入了进来。

sentences.en: Coordination meant that Ms. Costas' group could focus on case management, leaving job training, child care, and other services to fellow continuum members.
sentences.zh: 协调意味着科斯塔女士的团队可以专注于个案管理，而将职业培训、托儿和其他服务留给联合体的其他成员。

sentences.en: That, in turn, allowed it to avoid financial collapse and to hire more case managers, a critical need.
sentences.zh: 这反过来又使该机构避免了财务崩溃，并能够聘请更多的个案经理，这是一个紧迫的需求。

sentences.en: People were suddenly being housed with lightning speed, Ms. Costas recalled.
sentences.zh: 科斯塔回忆说，人们突然以闪电般的速度住进了房屋。

sentences.en: It was a phenomenal difference.
sentences.zh: 这是一个惊人的转变。

sentences.en: It helped, Ms. Parker says, quote, that back then we still had slack in our housing market and reasonably priced land.
sentences.zh: 帕克女士说：“当时我们的住房市场仍有余地，土地价格也合理，这起到了很大作用。”

sentences.en: It also helped that we created a center for sobriety, stopped arresting 20,000 people a year for public
sentences.zh: 我们建立了一个戒酒中心，不再每年因当众醉酒逮捕2万名市民，

sentences.en: intoxication, and started handing out taxi vouchers to homeless people so they wouldn't use ambulances as personal taxis.
sentences.zh: 并开始向流浪者发放出租车券，这样他们就不会把救护车当成私人出租车，这也发挥了作用。

sentences.en: All that saved us a fortune and made sense.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切为我们节省了一大笔钱，而且合情合理。

sentences.en: But the bottom line is that nearly everybody in Houston involved in homelessness got together around what works.
sentences.zh: 但最根本的是，休斯敦几乎所有参与解决流浪问题的人都围绕着“什么行之有效”团结在了一起。

sentences.en: That's our secret sauce.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的秘诀。

sentences.en: I struggled with this explanation.
sentences.zh: 我对这种解释感到费解。

sentences.en: Housing first is not a new idea after all.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，“住房优先”并不是一个新概念。

sentences.en: Other cities receive federal funds and have continuums of care.
sentences.zh: 其他城市也获得联邦资金并拥有照料联合体。

sentences.en: They don't achieve the same results.
sentences.zh: 但它们却没有取得相同的成果。

sentences.en: You can meet the letter of the law without embracing its true intent, is how Ms. Chapman Semple put it to me.
sentences.zh: 正如查普曼·森普尔对我说的那样，你可以做到字面上遵守法律，却没有领会其真正的意图。

sentences.en: San Diego, for example, another of the 10 cities targeted by the Obama administration, created a continuum.
sentences.zh: 例如，作为奥巴马政府把目标的10个城市之一，圣迭戈也建立了一个联合体。

sentences.en: But unlike Houston, which cut its homeless count by nearly two-thirds,
sentences.zh: 但与将其流浪人口减少了近三分之二的休斯敦不同，

sentences.en: San Diego was able to reduce the number by only 19 percent.
sentences.zh: 圣迭戈只将流浪人数减少了19%。

sentences.en: A 2020 city audit concluded because of a piecemeal approach to housing first and, quote, ineffective strategic planning.
sentences.zh: 2020年的一项城市审计得出结论，这是由于对“住房优先”采取了零敲碎打的方法，并且“战略规划无效”。

sentences.en: Atlanta, too, was adrift until neighboring counties dropped out of a joint continuum and the city set up its own, modeling its approach on Houston's.
sentences.zh: 亚特兰大也曾一度迷失方向，直到邻近各郡退出联合服务体，该市才建立了自己的联合体，并以休斯敦的方法为模板。

sentences.en: Atlanta has since cut its homeless numbers by 40 percent and gained increasing corporate support, a vital source of additional funding.
sentences.zh: 亚特兰大此后将流浪人口减少了40%，并获得了越来越多的企业支持，这是额外资金的重要来源。

sentences.en: When you get the public sector aligned, it becomes much easier to go to the private sector and say, join us, Catherine Vassell, who runs Atlanta's Continuum, told me.
sentences.zh: 亚特兰大联合体的负责人凯瑟琳·瓦塞尔对我说：“当你让公共部门保持一致时，去找私营部门说‘加入我们吧’就会容易得多。”

sentences.en: Getting businesses squarely behind solutions to homelessness beyond their usual token contributions is clearly a challenge in other places.
sentences.zh: 在其他地方，让企业真正全力支持解决流浪问题，而不仅仅是做出他们惯常的象征性捐款，显然是一个挑战。

sentences.en: In 2020, city councilors in Seattle approved a tax on businesses to support homeless housing, but the councilors rescinded the tax
